decision_reason: AAIB classifies the occurrence as an accident involving Air India Boeing 787-8 VT-ANB on scheduled passenger flight AI171. Its injuries table records 12 crew, 229 passengers and 19 others fatally injured; Boeing's contemporaneous statistical UNK exclusion is retained as a source-scope difference, not a BSFM exclusion.

location: Hong Kong International Airport, Hong Kong
source_publisher: Hong Kong Air Accident Investigation Authority
decision_reason: AAIA classifies the runway excursion as an accident involving Boeing 747-481 BDSF TC-ACF, serial 25645, on a cargo operation; four crew survived and two other persons were fatally injured. IATA/Boeing annual evidence independently reconciles the external-fatality event.
